issues.issue: Population text claims 'all triple-class exposed with a median of 5 prior lines of therapy (78% had at least 4 prior lines), 76% triple-class refractory' but the citation for prior lines refers to a different population than the efficacy N=110; more importantly the field mixes the '4 prior lines' indication threshold — the citation says median 5 (range 2-14), which is supported, but the phrasing is acceptable; however the '78%' and '76%' numbers ARE in citations, so this is supported.

AUTOMATED_FLAG 'uncited_number 4334' is a false positive — 4334 is a PMR/PMC study identifier (excluded category), not an efficacy/safety number, and it is supported elsewhere in the card's post_marketing citations.

The text states the confirmatory trial's 'primary endpoint progression-free survival, to verify clinical benefit' — 'primary endpoint progression-free survival' is supported by the line 37 citation, but 'to verify clinical benefit' is not in either quote for this PMR (it appears only in the separate generic accelerated-approval citation); minor overreach.

The text expands the redacted '[REDACTED] (b)(4)' quote to 'using a known amount of standard endotoxin,' which is not present in the citation quote (the quote is truncated/redacted), so the specific method described is not citation-supported.
